title: Variant diff surface notes and copy brainstorm
content:
Overview:
This is a short product design/engineering brainstorm for a compact 'variant diff' surface in the Model Catalog. The surface helps engineers compare up to three model variants, choose one to pin to an endpoint, and manage simple rollouts and fallbacks. The doc contains: layout sketches, prioritized backlog items, and microcopy candidates for tooltips, confirmations, and toasts.

MVP goals (lean):
- Side-by-side compact cards (1-3 variants).
- Key quick metrics: latency p50, cost/token estimate, active context support, and a recent eval score tied to the customer's default suite.
- Actions: Pin (with rollout options), Mark fallback, Run quick eval, Open full model page.
- Small sample snippet area (collapsible).
- Compatibility check pre-pin (context length/quantization).

Personas & success criteria:
- Backend engineer: can pick a variant meeting latency/cost SLO within 2 clicks.
- ML/product engineer: can validate variant quality via eval score and two sample outputs.
- Platform ops: can spot unstable/experimental variants and configure fallbacks.

Wireframe description for handoff (three frames):
Frame A — Compact row (default):
- Horizontal list of up to 3 variant cards. Card width ~300px.
- Header: Model name + variant tag + small provenance badge.
- Metric strip (single-line pills): [ p50 45ms ] [ $0.0008/token ] [ Eval 0.92 ] [ 16k context ]
- Actions row: Primary button: Pin version (solid) — secondary: Set fallback (outline) — kebab menu for more actions.
- Right-top: small stability icon (circle with amber/green/gray states). Hover reveals one-liner.

Frame B — Expanded card (user clicks sample):
- Reveals two short examples: "Typical" and "Worst-case" (2 lines each). Each example shows token count and a short rationale.
- Additional metrics: recent error rate (1h), throughput p95, last updated timestamp.

Frame C — Pin flow modal:
- Title: Confirm pin change
- Body: short diff: current pinned variant (metrics) -> selected variant (metrics).
- Rollout options: Immediate | Canary (pct + duration) | Manual
- Checkbox: Auto-revert on error threshold (recommended).
- Buttons: Cancel / Confirm and Deploy

States and behaviors:
- Already pinned: card shows "Pinned to <endpoint> by <owner> on <date>". Pin button becomes "Replace pinned variant".
- Incompatible: show inline red pill: "Incompatible: needs 32k context" and provide action: "Clone endpoint with suggested config".
- Concurrent edit conflict: friendly error: "Pin failed — <user> updated endpoint recently. Refresh to view latest or force replace."

Microcopy candidates (short snippets):
- Pin button label: "Pin version"
- Pin tooltip: "Lock this variant to an endpoint so traffic uses this exact version until changed."
- Confirm modal title: "Confirm pin change"
- Confirm modal body: "Replacing the pinned variant will route traffic to the new version. Choose a rollout option below. You can set a fallback to auto-failover on errors."
- Rollout label: "Rollout strategy" with options: "Immediate (all traffic)", "Canary (10% for 15m)", "Manual"
- Success toast: "Pinned <variant> to <endpoint>." with action link "View endpoint"
- Fallback toast: "Fallback set — traffic will failover to <fallback> if checks fail."
- Compatibility inline: "Cannot pin — variant requires 32k context. Clone endpoint or update config."
- Stability tooltip: "Stable: recommended for production. Experimental: behavior may change. Deprecated: do not use for new endpoints."

Backlog (prioritized):
1) Compact variant cards + metric strip (MVP) — Owner: Product/Frontend; Est: 5pts
2) Pin modal with rollout + compatibility check — Owner: Core API + Frontend; Est: 8pts
3) Endpoint clone prefill flow for incompatibilities — Owner: Endpoint service; Est: 5pts
4) Expandable sample outputs + storage — Owner: Storage team; Est: 3pts
5) Audit trail UI for pin events (last 10) — Owner: Observability; Est: 5pts
6) Trigger user eval from catalog and show quick results — Owner: ML infra; Est: 8pts

Acceptance criteria notes for tickets:
- Metrics freshness: for hosted models metrics < 1h old; show last-updated timestamp.
- Pin idempotency: API safe to retry, returns clear conflict errors.
- Rollout safety: canary supports pct + duration and auto-revert threshold.

Open decisions:
- Allow same variant pinned to multiple endpoints? (platform to decide)
- Default rollout for pin: immediate or small canary? (PM decision)
- Expose cost/token only to billing/admin roles?
- Multi-eval suites: show the team default suite only, link to full eval dashboard.

Acceptance/regression test notes:
- Add e2e flow test: pin new variant -> canary config -> simulate error -> assert auto-revert.
- UI tests for compatibility flows (show clone endpoint CTA).

Design handoff checklist:
- Deliver 3 wireframe frames (compact, expanded, confirm modal).
- Component spec for metric pills (colors, thresholds).
- Microcopy file: final snippets for buttons, tooltips, toasts.
- Accessibility review: color + icon semantics for stability and alerts.

Experiment idea (post-MVP):
- Suggested variant badge: system recommends a variant when it can reduce cost while staying within quality bounds. Microcopy: "Suggested to cut ~30% cost while keeping eval delta < 2%." Clicking opens pre-populated compare modal.

Notes from grooming (2026-02-28):
- Arjun: prefer showing both p50 and p95 latency on expand; p95 optional in compact.
- Maya: include short "why this sample" line under each sample to help product reviews.
- Samira: require a clear cost signal before allowing pin for non-admins.
- Owen: add error-rate metric to expanded data (post-MVP).

Revision history (included in document body):
- 2026-02-20 initial draft (Leah Rivera)
- 2026-02-28 grooming notes appended
- 2026-03-10 added backlog priorities and acceptance criteria

End of document.
